method: state[k] := the five cycle-cell values just BEFORE the (k+1)-th execution of N1 (i.e., after k ticks and their carry cascade). post_halt := state at program halt.
claim: MOD59049_BOUNDARY=DEMONSTRATED: after 59049 ticks and their carry cascade the state returns exactly to the initial state (wrap), and the last steps are all distinct.
correction: The first version of this file captured the state right after the k-th N1 execution before carries; that phase shift made the wrap comparison wrong. This version defines the state at the carry-settled phase.
scope: state is the tuple of cycle-cell values (the counter representation), not a single tape word.
